q1.question: How do I cancel a booking?
q1.answer: Go to My Bookings, select the booking, and tap Cancel. Cancellations made more than 2 hours before the scheduled start are free. Cancelling after work has begun may incur a partial fee based on work completed.

q2.question: How do I report a problem with a Krafter?
q2.answer: Open the booking and tap Report an Issue. Describe what happened and attach photos if you have them — our team reviews reports within 24–48 hours and will follow up directly.

q3.question: How do I request a refund?
q3.answer: Your payment is held securely until the job is marked complete. For instant refunds (no-show or cancelled before the start), funds are released automatically. For quality disputes, open the booking, tap Request Refund, and explain the issue — if approved, funds are returned to your original payment method within 5–7 business days.

q4.question: What happens if a Krafter doesn't show up?
q4.answer: Tap Report No-Show on the booking. Since payment hasn't been released yet, you'll get a full refund automatically, and you can rebook with another available Krafter right away.

q5.question: How do I update my payment method?
q5.answer: Go to Settings → Payment Methods, where you can add a new card, set a default, or remove an old one anytime.

q1.question: What happens if a client cancels on me?
q1.answer: If a client cancels after you've confirmed the job, you may be entitled to a cancellation fee depending on how much notice they gave and whether you'd already started work. Cancellations made well ahead of your scheduled start time are not compensated.

q2.question: How do I get paid?
q2.answer: Once you mark the job complete and the client confirms (or the review window passes without a dispute), your payment is released from escrow to your linked payout account. Payouts typically land within 2–3 business days.

q3.question: What happens if a client doesn't show up?
q3.answer: Tap Report Client No-Show on the booking once your scheduled start time has passed. Once confirmed, you'll receive your agreed-upon callout fee and the booking closes — no further action needed on your end.

q4.question: How do I report a problem with a client?
q4.answer: Open the booking and tap Report an Issue, describing what happened. Our team reviews flagged bookings and may restrict that client's ability to book again while we investigate.

q5.question: How do I update my payout method?
q5.answer: Go to Settings → Payout Details to update your linked bank account or card. Changes take effect from your next payout cycle.
